title: Title Tag Best Practices
content: Title tags are one of the most important on-page SEO elements. They appear in search results and browser tabs.
guidelines: Include primary keyword near the beginning
Make each title unique and descriptive
Include brand name at the end (optional)
Write for humans first, search engines second

good: SEO Guide 2024: Complete Beginner's Tutorial | Brand
Best Running Shoes for Marathon Training - Brand
How to Write Title Tags That Get Clicks (2024 Guide)
bad: Welcome to our website where we offer the best services in the industry

title: Title Tag Length Checker
description: Check if your title tag is the optimal length for search engines
tips: Test your titles in Google's search results preview
